claims.claim: Implemented repository-owned execution-profile policy and provider-neutral profile contract/resolver preserving TASK-061 defaults for Codex and Antigravity while rejecting malformed data without creating model router.

Codex and Antigravity adapters no longer own default-selection policy; exact injected profile model/effort values reach PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR native command arguments while existing behavior remains unchanged.
Bounded synthetic future model identifier and valid alternate effort reach native command construction without global allowlist, while invalid effort fails before native invocation.

Canonical Codex and Antigravity native invocations have an exact immutable execution-profile sidecar persisted before native runner entry; executor/profile mismatch or conflicting sidecar invokes zero native Executors.
Profile persistence is deterministic and idempotent; subsequent policy changes do not alter already-bound RUN profiles, and native failure leaves attempted profile provenance available.

Successful and failed managed RUN terminal artifact refs include exact execution-profile provenance with idempotent content checks, while historical terminal artifacts lacking the profile remain valid.
No-native-invocation paths create no execution-profile artifact, and Antigravity MiniMax behavior remains unchanged.
Preserved production defaults at Codex gpt-5.6-sol/high and Antigravity gemini-3.8-flash/high, leaving Human-facing CLI/carrier selection unchanged pending TASK-163 activation.
Frozen TASK/RUN/RunLease/ExecutorBoundary semantics, verification, and roadmap boundaries remain unchanged, allowing future compatible model updates via profile policy and smoke validation.
